name: odysseus_vigil
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Reference 1 is the exact Odysseus face identity: natural shorter straight nose, broad olive mature face, thick brown beard, wavy brown hair, natural closed lips (no missing teeth, no caricature). Reference 2 defines his bronze owl cuirass, dark leather skirt, bronze greaves, sandals, red cloak and CLOSED leather wind bag with gold spiral and tightly tied teal/gold cords. In EVERY cell SAME Odysseus seated on a small low wooden ship crate, both feet grounded, bag securely resting on his lap. Same figure size, same crate and ground baseline. TOP LEFT alert seated upright gazing three-quarter LEFT, both hands protecting closed bag. TOP RIGHT exhausted heavy eyelids head lowered slightly, one hand supporting forehead, other securing bag on lap. BOTTOM LEFT waking suddenly, eyes alert, back upright, one hand rubbing brow, other holds bag closed. Complete natural seated anatomy, readable subtle face changes. Dense detailed colored pixel-art same as references, no background, no text, no glow. Preserve exact original face across four poses.

name: deck_ithaca
